points.title: 童年与少年时期
points.description: 鲁迅原名周树人，1881年出生于浙江绍兴一个没落的封建士大夫家庭。童年时期，他经历了家道中落，祖父因科举舞弊案入狱，父亲长期患病去世，这些经历深刻影响了他对封建社会的认识。在私塾接受传统教育，同时接触了大量古典文学，尤其是《资治通鉴》等史书，培养了深厚的文学功底和批判精神。这段时期的生活经历为他后来的文学创作提供了丰富的素材和思想基础。
points.descriptionEn: Born Zhou Shuren in Shaoxing, Zhejiang, Lu Xun came from a declining feudal gentry family. His childhood was marked by family decline, his grandfather's imprisonment due to a imperial examination scandal, and his father's long illness and eventual death. These experiences profoundly shaped his understanding of feudal society. He received traditional education in private schools while extensively studying classical literature, particularly historical texts like 'Zizhi Tongjian', which cultivated his deep literary foundation and critical spirit. These formative experiences provided rich material and ideological foundation for his later literary works.

points.title: 留学日本
points.description: 1902年，鲁迅赴日本留学，先在弘文学院学习日语和基础科学，后进入仙台医学专门学校学医。在日本期间，他受到西方思想影响，开始接触进化论等西方学说。1906年，他在课堂幻灯片上看到中国人围观同胞被日军处决的麻木神情，深受刺激，决定弃医从文，认为改变国民精神比治疗身体疾病更为重要。这一决定标志着他人生道路的重大转折，也奠定了他后来文学创作的方向——以文学唤醒民众，改造国民性。
points.descriptionEn: In 1902, Lu Xun went to Japan for further studies, first studying Japanese and basic sciences at Kobun Gakuin, then entering the Sendai Medical College. During his time in Japan, he was influenced by Western thought and began studying Western theories such as evolutionism. In 1906, he was deeply shocked by seeing the apathetic expressions of Chinese people watching their compatriots being executed by Japanese soldiers in a classroom slide. This experience led him to abandon medicine for literature, believing that changing the national spirit was more important than treating physical diseases. This decision marked a major turning point in his life and established the direction of his later literary work—using literature to awaken the public and transform the national character.

points.title: 新文化运动时期
points.description: 1912年，鲁迅应蔡元培邀请到北京教育部工作，后在北京大学、北京师范大学等校任教。这一时期，他积极参与新文化运动，成为新文化运动的重要旗手。1918年，他在《新青年》上发表中国现代文学史上第一篇白话小说《狂人日记》，以犀利的笔锋揭露封建礼教的吃人本质。此后陆续创作《阿Q正传》《药》《祝福》等经典作品，深刻批判封建制度和国民劣根性。同时，他参与创办《语丝》等进步刊物，翻译介绍外国文学，推动了中国现代文学的发展。北京时期是鲁迅文学创作的黄金时代，他的作品对中国现代文学产生了深远影响。
points.descriptionEn: In 1912, Lu Xun was invited to work at the Ministry of Education in Beijing by Cai Yuanpei, and later taught at Peking University and Beijing Normal University. During this period, he actively participated in the New Culture Movement, becoming one of its important leaders. In 1918, he published 'A Madman's Diary', the first vernacular short story in modern Chinese literature, in 'New Youth', sharply exposing the cannibalistic nature of feudal ethics. He subsequently created classic works such as 'The True Story of Ah Q', 'Medicine', and 'The New Year's Sacrifice', profoundly criticizing feudal institutions and national weaknesses. Meanwhile, he participated in founding progressive publications like 'Yu Si' and translated foreign literature, promoting the development of modern Chinese literature. His Beijing period was the golden age of his literary creation, and his works had a profound impact on modern Chinese literature.

points.title: 南下任教
points.description: 1926年，鲁迅离开北京南下，先后在厦门大学、中山大学任教。在广州期间，他经历了四一二反革命政变，对国民党右派的背叛感到极度失望和愤怒。这一时期，他的思想更加激进，开始接触马克思主义理论。1927年，他写下《小杂感》等杂文，表达了对时局的深刻忧虑和对革命前途的思考。在广州的短暂停留虽然不长，但对他思想的发展产生了重要影响，使他更加坚定了以文学为武器进行社会批判的决心，也为他后来转向左翼文学奠定了思想基础。
points.descriptionEn: In 1926, Lu Xun left Beijing and went south, teaching at Xiamen University and Sun Yat-sen University. During his time in Guangzhou, he experienced the April 12th Counter-revolutionary Coup, feeling extremely disappointed and angry at the betrayal of the Kuomintang rightists. During this period, his thoughts became more radical, and he began to engage with Marxist theory. In 1927, he wrote essays like 'Miscellaneous Notes', expressing his deep concerns about the current situation and thoughts on the revolutionary future. Although his stay in Guangzhou was brief, it had a significant impact on the development of his thoughts, making him more determined to use literature as a weapon for social criticism and laying the ideological foundation for his later turn to left-wing literature.

points.title: 左翼文学领袖
points.description: 1930年，鲁迅定居上海，成为中国左翼作家联盟的领袖和旗帜。在上海期间，他积极参与左翼文化运动，领导左联开展文学创作和理论建设，同时与国民党文化专制进行坚决斗争。这一时期，他创作了大量杂文，如《且介亭杂文》《二心集》等，犀利批判社会现实和文化专制。他还翻译介绍马克思主义文艺理论，培养青年作家，推动了中国左翼文学的发展。面对国民党的文化围剿，他坚持斗争，表现出坚定的革命立场和不屈的战斗精神。1936年10月19日，鲁迅在上海病逝，终年55岁。他的去世引起全国哀悼，成为中国现代文化史上的重大事件。
points.descriptionEn: In 1930, Lu Xun settled in Shanghai and became the leader and banner of the Chinese League of Left-wing Writers. During his time in Shanghai, he actively participated in the left-wing cultural movement, leading the League in literary creation and theoretical development, while resolutely fighting against Kuomintang cultural autocracy. During this period, he wrote numerous essays such as 'Qiejieting Miscellaneous Essays' and 'Dual Collections', sharply criticizing social reality and cultural autocracy. He also translated and introduced Marxist literary theory, trained young writers, and promoted the development of Chinese left-wing literature. Facing the Kuomintang's cultural suppression, he persisted in his struggle, demonstrating firm revolutionary stance and indomitable fighting spirit. On October 19, 1936, Lu Xun passed away in Shanghai at the age of 55. His death caused national mourning and became a significant event in the history of modern Chinese culture.

supporter.zh: 鲁迅被誉为中国现代文学的奠基人，是中国现代文化史上最伟大的思想家之一。他以其犀利的笔锋和深刻的思想，揭露封建礼教的吃人本质，批判国民劣根性，唤醒民众的觉醒。他的作品不仅具有极高的文学价值，更承载着强烈的社会责任感和历史使命感。鲁迅精神——批判、反思、抗争，已成为中国知识分子的精神象征，激励着一代又一代中国人追求真理、改造社会。
supporter.en: Lu Xun is hailed as the founder of modern Chinese literature and one of the greatest thinkers in the history of modern Chinese culture. With his sharp pen and profound thoughts, he exposed the cannibalistic nature of feudal ethics, criticized national weaknesses, and awakened public consciousness. His works not only possess high literary value but also carry strong social responsibility and historical mission. The Lu Xun spirit—criticism, reflection, and resistance—has become a spiritual symbol for Chinese intellectuals, inspiring generations of Chinese people to pursue truth and transform society.

critic.zh: 鲁迅的批评者认为他过于激进和偏激，对传统文化全盘否定，缺乏建设性意见。有人指责他后期政治立场过于左倾，与共产党的关系过于密切，影响了其文学创作的独立性和客观性。此外，也有人认为鲁迅作品中存在过多的悲观情绪和虚无主义倾向，对中国的未来缺乏信心。这些批评反映了鲁迅思想的复杂性和历史局限性，也提醒我们应当全面、辩证地看待这位文化巨匠的思想遗产。
critic.en: Critics of Lu Xun argue that he was too radical and extreme, completely negating traditional culture without offering constructive alternatives. Some accuse him of being overly leftist in his later political stance, maintaining too close a relationship with the Communist Party, which affected the independence and objectivity of his literary creation. Additionally, some believe his works contain excessive pessimism and nihilistic tendencies, showing a lack of confidence in China's future. These criticisms reflect the complexity and historical limitations of Lu Xun's thoughts, reminding us to view this cultural giant's legacy comprehensively and dialectically.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，鲁迅被定义为一位复杂而多维的文化符号。他既是文学巨匠，也是社会批判家；既是传统文化的叛逆者，也是新文化的建设者。鲁迅的作品已成为中国现代文学的经典，他的思想影响了中国几代知识分子。在当代中国，鲁迅被广泛视为民族精神的象征，他的名言'横眉冷对千夫指，俯首甘为孺子牛'成为许多知识分子的座右铭。鲁迅的形象已经超越了单纯的文学家，成为中国文化抵抗精神和社会批判意识的象征，在全球化时代依然具有重要的现实意义。
objective.en: In historical scholarship and popular culture, Lu Xun is defined as a complex and multi-dimensional cultural symbol. He was both a literary giant and a social critic; both a rebel against traditional culture and a builder of new culture. Lu Xun's works have become classics of modern Chinese literature, and his thoughts have influenced several generations of Chinese intellectuals. In contemporary China, Lu Xun is widely regarded as a symbol of national spirit, and his famous quote 'Frowning in defiance of a thousand pointing fingers, I bow my head willing to be an ox for the children' has become a motto for many intellectuals. Lu Xun's image has transcended that of a mere writer, becoming a symbol of Chinese cultural resistance and social critique, maintaining significant relevance in the era of globalization.

self.zh: 横眉冷对千夫指，俯首甘为孺子牛。
self.en: Frowning in defiance of a thousand pointing fingers, I bow my head willing to be an ox for the children.

others.zh: 鲁迅的骨头是最硬的，他没有丝毫的奴颜和媚骨，这是殖民地半殖民地人民最可宝贵的性格。
others.en: Lu Xun's bones were the hardest; he had not the slightest servile expression or fawning attitude. This is the most precious character of the people in colonial and semi-colonial countries.
